title: Cousins Properties Announces Dates for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Cousins Properties (NYSE: CUZ) announced today that it will release its second quarter 2026 earnings after the market closes on Thursday, July 30, 2026 . Cousins will hold its second quarter 2026 earnings conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) . The number for this call is (800) 836-8184 . The live webcast of this call can be accessed on the Company's website, www.cousins.com , through the "Cousins Properties Second Quarter Conference Call" link on the Investors page. A playback will be available shortly after the call on Friday, July 31, 2026 and run through Friday, August 7, 2026. The number for the playback is ( 888) 660-6345 , passcode 33580#. The playback can also be accessed on the Company's website through the "Cousins Properties Second Quarter Conference Call" link on the Investors page.
